## Astro
Use this domain inside Astro projects. This domain enables rules that are specific to Astro projects.
### Astro activation
Enable the **recommended, non-nursery** rules of the domain:
```json title="biome.json" ins={3-5}
{
	"linter": {
		"domains": {
			"astro": "recommended"
		}
	}
}
```

:::note[No recommended rules]
Since all rules in this domain are nursery rules, no rules will be activated when enabling the domain. You need to enable the single rules.
:::
Enabled the **all** rules of the domain:
```json title="biome.json" ins={3-5}
{
	"linter": {
		"domains": {
			"astro": "all"
		}
	}
}
```
**Disable** all rules of the domain:
```json title="biome.json" ins={3-5}
{
	"linter": {
		"domains": {
			"astro": "none"
		}
	}
}
```
### Astro dependencies
Enabled when the following dependencies are declared:
- `astro`: `>=1.0.0`

### Astro rules
Rules that belong to the domain:
- [noAstroSetHtmlDirective](/linter/rules/no-astro-set-html-directive/html) [(nursery)](/linter/#nursery)
- [useAstroClientOnlyDirectiveValue](/linter/rules/use-astro-client-only-directive-value/html) [(nursery)](/linter/#nursery)

```json title="biome.json" ins={3-5}
	"linter": {
		"domains": {
			"playwright": "recommended"
		}
	}
}
```

Since all rules in this domain are nursery rules, no rules will be activated when enabling the domain. You need to enable the single rules.

Enabled the **all** rules of the domain:

## Project
This domain contains rules that perform project-level analysis. This includes our module graph for dependency resolution. When enabling rules that belong to this domain, Biome will scan the entire project. The scanning phase will have a performance impact on the linting process. See the documentation on our [scanner](/internals/architecture/#scanner) to learn more about the scanner.
### Project activation
Enable the **recommended, non-nursery** rules of the domain:
```json title="biome.json" ins={3-5}
{
	"linter": {
		"domains": {
			"project": "recommended"
		}
	}
}
```
Enabled the **all** rules of the domain:
```json title="biome.json" ins={3-5}
{
	"linter": {
		"domains": {
			"project": "all"
		}
	}
}
```
**Disable** all rules of the domain:
```json title="biome.json" ins={3-5}
{
	"linter": {
		"domains": {
			"project": "none"
		}
	}
}
```
### Project rules
Rules that belong to the domain:
- [noPrivateImports](/linter/rules/no-private-imports/javascript) (recommended)
- [noUndeclaredDependencies](/linter/rules/no-undeclared-dependencies/javascript)
- [noUnresolvedImports](/linter/rules/no-unresolved-imports/javascript)
- [useImportExtensions](/linter/rules/use-import-extensions/javascript)
- [useJsonImportAttributes](/linter/rules/use-json-import-attributes/javascript)
- [noUndeclaredClasses](/linter/rules/no-undeclared-classes/javascript) [(nursery)](/linter/#nursery)
- [noUndeclaredCustomProperties](/linter/rules/no-undeclared-custom-properties/javascript) [(nursery)](/linter/#nursery)
- [noDeprecatedImports](/linter/rules/no-deprecated-imports/javascript)
- [noImportCycles](/linter/rules/no-import-cycles/javascript)
- [noUntrustedLicenses](/linter/rules/no-untrusted-licenses/json) [(nursery)](/linter/#nursery)
- [noUndeclaredCustomProperties](/linter/rules/no-undeclared-custom-properties/css) [(nursery)](/linter/#nursery)
- [noUnusedClasses](/linter/rules/no-unused-classes/css) [(nursery)](/linter/#nursery)
- [noUndeclaredClasses](/linter/rules/no-undeclared-classes/html) [(nursery)](/linter/#nursery)
- [noUndeclaredCustomProperties](/linter/rules/no-undeclared-custom-properties/html) [(nursery)](/linter/#nursery)

```json title="biome.json" ins={3-5}
	"linter": {

		}
	}
}
```

```json title="biome.json" ins={3-5}
	"linter": {
		"domains": {
			"turborepo": "none"
		}
	}
}
```
### Turborepo dependencies
Enabled when the following dependencies are declared:
- `turbo`: `>=1.0.0`

### Turborepo rules
Rules that belong to the domain:
- [noUndeclaredEnvVars](/linter/rules/no-undeclared-env-vars/javascript) (recommended)
## Types
This domain contains rules that perform project-level analysis. This includes our module graph for dependency resolution. When enabling rules that belong to this domain, Biome will scan the entire project, *and it will enable the inference engine to resolve and flat types*. The scanning phase will have a performance impact on the linting process. See the documentation on our [scanner](/internals/architecture/#scanner) to learn more about the scanner.
### Types activation
Enable the **recommended, non-nursery** rules of the domain:
```json title="biome.json" ins={3-5}
{
	"linter": {
		"domains": {
			"types": "recommended"
		}
	}
}
```
Enabled the **all** rules of the domain:
```json title="biome.json" ins={3-5}
{
	"linter": {
		"domains": {
			"types": "all"
		}
	}
}
```
**Disable** all rules of the domain:
```json title="biome.json" ins={3-5}
{
	"linter": {
		"domains": {
			"types": "none"
		}
	}
}
```
### Types rules
Rules that belong to the domain:
- [useArrayFind](/linter/rules/use-array-find/javascript)
- [noBaseToString](/linter/rules/no-base-to-string/javascript) [(nursery)](/linter/#nursery)
- [noFloatingPromises](/linter/rules/no-floating-promises/javascript) [(nursery)](/linter/#nursery)
- [noMisleadingReturnType](/linter/rules/no-misleading-return-type/javascript) [(nursery)](/linter/#nursery)
- [noMisusedPromises](/linter/rules/no-misused-promises/javascript) [(nursery)](/linter/#nursery)
- [noUnsafePlusOperands](/linter/rules/no-unsafe-plus-operands/javascript) [(nursery)](/linter/#nursery)
- [noUselessTypeConversion](/linter/rules/no-useless-type-conversion/javascript) [(nursery)](/linter/#nursery)
- [useAwaitThenable](/linter/rules/use-await-thenable/javascript) [(nursery)](/linter/#nursery)
- [useDisposables](/linter/rules/use-disposables/javascript) [(nursery)](/linter/#nursery)
- [useExhaustiveSwitchCases](/linter/rules/use-exhaustive-switch-cases/javascript) [(nursery)](/linter/#nursery)
- [useIncludes](/linter/rules/use-includes/javascript) [(nursery)](/linter/#nursery)
- [useNullishCoalescing](/linter/rules/use-nullish-coalescing/javascript) [(nursery)](/linter/#nursery)

## Vue
Use this domain inside Vue projects. This domain enables rules that are specific to Vue projects.
### Vue activation
Enable the **recommended, non-nursery** rules of the domain:
```json title="biome.json" ins={3-5}
{
	"linter": {
		"domains": {
			"vue": "recommended"
		}
	}
}
```
Enabled the **all** rules of the domain:
```json title="biome.json" ins={3-5}
{
	"linter": {
		"domains": {
			"vue": "all"
		}
	}
}
```
**Disable** all rules of the domain:
```json title="biome.json" ins={3-5}
{
	"linter": {
		"domains": {
			"vue": "none"
		}
	}
}
```
### Vue dependencies
Enabled when the following dependencies are declared:
- `vue`: `>=3.0.0`
